description: This file defines constants and declares functions related to ISO8601 date and time formatting and parsing utilities.

methods.name: iso8601_cur_time
methods.description: Returns the current time in ISO8601 format, writing to the provided buffer.

methods.name: iso8601_from_unix_time
methods.description: Converts a UNIX timestamp to an ISO8601 formatted string, storing it in the buffer.

methods.name: iso8601_strftime
methods.description: Formats a tm structure into an ISO8601 string.

methods.name: iso8601_us_strftime
methods.description: Formats a timeval structure into an ISO8601 string with microsecond precision.

methods.name: iso8601_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given ISO8601 date string is valid.

methods.name: iso8601_to_unix_time
methods.description: Converts an ISO8601 date string to a UNIX timestamp.

methods.name: uptime_strftime
methods.description: Formats an uptime (in seconds) as a string.
